raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Disclosure

AI assistance was used. The changes were reviewed and tested manually.

## Overview

Allow compatible layers to use AITER fused shared experts (FSE) while other layers retain higher-precision shared experts.

Current vLLM rejects the entire model in case FSE can't be enabled for all layers, and various places assume all-or-nothing selection.

**Motivation: certain layers are less sensitive to MXFP4 shared expert quantization than others, and fusion can be enabled for them.**

## Claims

- Enable per-layer FSE through the existing `resolve_layer_fused_shared_expert` API for models migrated to layer-scoped checkpoint loading.
- Redirect checkpoint weights only for layers that allocated fused shared-expert slots; preserve separate MXFP8 shared experts alongside MXFP4 routed experts.
- Explicitly reject mixed FSE with EPLB, whose expert-weight handling assumes uniform row counts across layers.

Left to other PRs:

- [ ] Migrate MiniMax M3 to `resolve_layer_fused_shared_expert` and layer-scoped checkpoint loading: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/12b005eefa06f97eeebfae3e14bcac5fa3b81197/vllm/models/minimax_m3/amd/model.py#L393-L414 and https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/12b005eefa06f97eeebfae3e14bcac5fa3b81197/vllm/models/minimax_m3/amd/model.py#L1560-L1561
- [ ] Migrate DeepSeek V4 to `resolve_layer_fused_shared_expert` and finish layer-scoped checkpoint mapping: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/12b005eefa06f97eeebfae3e14bcac5fa3b81197/vllm/models/deepseek_v4/amd/model.py#L643-L662 and https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/12b005eefa06f97eeebfae3e14bcac5fa3b81197/vllm/models/deepseek_v4/amd/model.py#L1392-L1396
- [ ] Move FHMOE's separate model-wide eligibility policy to this per-layer API: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/12b005eefa06f97eeebfae3e14bcac5fa3b81197/vllm/models/deepseek_v4/amd/model.py#L212-L240 and https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/12b005eefa06f97eeebfae3e14bcac5fa3b81197/vllm/models/deepseek_v4/amd/model.py#L1077-L1092
- [ ] Update remaining model-specific loaders to redirect shared weights and build expert mappings per layer:
  - DeepSeek V2: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/12b005eefa06f97eeebfae3e14bcac5fa3b81197/vllm/model_executor/models/deepseek_v2.py#L1627-L1664
  - DeepSeek V3.2: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/12b005eefa06f97eeebfae3e14bcac5fa3b81197/vllm/models/deepseek_v32/amd/model.py#L232-L258
  - GLM5Next: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/12b005eefa06f97eeebfae3e14bcac5fa3b81197/vllm/models/glm5next/common/model.py#L892-L902 and https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/12b005eefa06f97eeebfae3e14bcac5fa3b81197/vllm/models/glm5next/common/model.py#L929-L930
  - AXK1: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/12b005eefa06f97eeebfae3e14bcac5fa3b81197/vllm/model_executor/models/AXK1.py#L825-L852
  - GLM4 Lite: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/12b005eefa06f97eeebfae3e14bcac5fa3b81197/vllm/model_executor/models/glm4_moe_lite.py#L361-L387
  - Applicable MTP loaders: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/12b005eefa06f97eeebfae3e14bcac5fa3b81197/vllm/model_executor/models/deepseek_mtp.py#L327-L353, https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/12b005eefa06f97eeebfae3e14bcac5fa3b81197/vllm/models/deepseek_v32/amd/mtp.py#L277-L303, https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/12b005eefa06f97eeebfae3e14bcac5fa3b81197/vllm/models/glm5next/common/mtp.py#L309-L320, https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/12b005eefa06f97eeebfae3e14bcac5fa3b81197/vllm/models/glm5next/common/mtp.py#L342-L343, and https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/12b005eefa06f97eeebfae3e14bcac5fa3b81197/vllm/model_executor/models/glm4_moe_lite_mtp.py#L290-L305

Limitations:

- Mixed FSE with EPLB is unsupported.
- Routed and shared experts must have compatible quantization within each fused layer; heterogeneous precision inside one fused GEMM is unsupported.
- Fused layers must share routing-buffer geometry; Mori remains unsupported with FSE requested.
- Forward execution, graph replay, model evaluations, and performance are not validated; Qwen4 Exp lacks full FSE initialization/loading coverage.

## Validation

- `pytest tests/model_executor/layers/test_fused_shared_expert.py -k test_models_fse_init -s -vvvvv`
- `python -m pytest tests/model_executor/layers/test_fused_shared_expert.py tests/models/qwen4_exp/test_config.py -s -vvvvv`

## Compatibility changes

- Compared with `main`, migrated models accept mixed fusion eligibility with EPLB off, retaining incompatible shared experts separately at their configured precision.
- Internal breaking changes: `maybe_fuse_shared_experts()` requires a `fused_shared_expert_layers` collection instead of the optional `enabled` boolean/environment fallback; migrated model-wide FSE booleans become layer lists; `FusedMoEConfig.aiter_fmoe_shared_expert_enabled` becomes `is_fused_shared_expert_requested`.

## Related work

- This addresses per-layer policy, not the ModelOpt MXFP8 compatibility support in https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/57916; the duplicate-work search found no open PR implementing this same policy migration.

+
+            checkpoint = []

+            for idx, layer in enumerate(model.layers):
+                fused = expected_policy[f"layers.{idx}.mlp"]
+                high_precision = idx == 1 and shared_expert_precision == "mixed"
+                dtype = (
+                    torch.bfloat16

+                            ]
+                        )

+            for idx in range(2):
+                prefix = f"layers.{idx}.mlp"
+                expected_name = (
+                    f"{prefix}.experts.routed_experts.w2_weight"
+                    if expected_policy[prefix]
+                    else f"{prefix}.{shared_name}.down_proj.weight"
+                )
+                assert expected_name in loaded
+                if shared_name == "shared_expert":
+                    assert f"{prefix}.shared_expert_gate.weight" in loaded
+            for target, weight in expected_weights:
+                torch.testing.assert_close(
+                    target[: weight.shape[0], : weight.shape[1]].float(), weight.float()
+                )
+        else:
